nodes.label: Settings capability context
nodes.rationale: Settings control CLI defaults, output rendering, and application-data path overrides. LLM and OCR settings are not part of this repo (ADR 0007, ADR 0010). App-data override affects default morphology and dictionary SQLite locations. settings create currently writes JSON text to .wyrdcraeft.toml and should be treated as current behavior. Config precedence in Settings.settings_customise_sources needs close reading before it is changed.

nodes.label: ADR 0007
nodes.rationale: LLM and OCR settings are outside this repo's settings capability, together with ADR 0010.

nodes.label: Settings and app-data paths
nodes.rationale: The root command constructs Settings once and stores it on the click context. --config-file is applied by setting WYRDCRAEFT_CONFIG_FILE before load. Environment variables use the WYRDCRAEFT_ prefix. App-data path resolution is what moves the default morphology and dictionary SQLite files.
